# Microsoft Learn

> > Microsoft's official learning platform for building technical skills across Azure, Microsoft 365, AI development, and cloud technologies with hands-on training, certifications, and skill validation programs.

Microsoft Learn serves as the comprehensive hub for professional development, offering interactive training modules, learning paths, certifications (Microsoft Certifications and Applied Skills), and technical documentation. The platform covers key Microsoft technologies including Azure cloud services, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Semantic Kernel AI SDK, Windows lifecycle management, and developer tools like Visual Studio App Center.

## Key Topics

- Azure cloud platform and Azure Fundamentals
- Microsoft 365 Copilot and productivity tools
- Microsoft Certifications and Applied Skills validation
- AI development with Semantic Kernel SDK (C#, Python, Java)
- Windows 11 and Windows 10 lifecycle management
- Cloud skills and career development
- Learning paths and interactive training modules
- Microsoft Credentials program
- Visual Studio App Center for mobile development
- Office 365 security and compliance
- Modern Lifecycle Policy and Windows as a Service (WaaS)
- Student certification programs
- Community support and Microsoft Q&A

## Training and Learning Paths

- [Microsoft Learn: Build skills that open doors in your career](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/): Microsoft Learn homepage for Azure, Copilot training and certifications
- [Training - Courses, Learning Paths, Modules](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/): Main training hub for interactive modules, learning paths, and courses
- [Training for Microsoft 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/m365/): Microsoft 365 training paths for Office 365, security, and compliance
- [Microsoft Learn for Organizations](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/course-videos-on-shows): On-demand video training from Microsoft Certified Trainers for orgs

## Certifications and Credentials

- [Professional and Technical Credentials and Certifications](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/credentials/): Microsoft Credentials hub for certifications and Applied Skills programs
- [Microsoft Applied Skills](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/credentials/applied-skills/): Lab-based skill validation for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Azure
- [Student Certifications - Student Hub](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/student-hub/certifications): Student certification guide with Azure and C# exam discounts

## AI and Developer Tools

- [Introduction to Semantic Kernel](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/semantic-kernel/overview/): Getting started with Semantic Kernel SDK for C#, Python, Java AI agents
- [Visual Studio App Center](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/appcenter/): Visual Studio App Center docs for monitoring Android, iOS, macOS apps

## Windows Lifecycle and Support

- [Windows 11 Home and Pro - Microsoft Lifecycle](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/lifecycle/products/windows-11-home-and-pro): Windows 11 Home/Pro lifecycle support dates and version releases
- [Windows 10 Home and Pro - Microsoft Lifecycle](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/lifecycle/products/windows-10-home-and-pro): Windows 10 Home/Pro end-of-support dates and retirement schedule

## Community and Support

- [Microsoft Learn Community](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/learn-community): Community hub connecting learners with peers and Microsoft Q&A experts

## Optional Resources

- [Whois - Sysinternals](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sysinternals/downloads/whois): Whois command-line tool by Mark Russinovich for domain/IP lookup
- [Arial Black font family - Typography](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/typography/font-list/arial-black): Arial Black font specs by Robin Nicholas and Patricia Saunders
